items.title: Pick small podcasts
items.say: One. Pick small podcasts that post full episodes but no clips.

items.title: Clip it for free first
items.say: Two. Make three clips from their latest episode first.

items.title: Send them, then pitch
items.say: Three. Send the clips, then pitch a monthly deal.
